create_batch_env: create a BatchEnv instance combining multiple gym environments with blocking or non-blocking mode
step_batch_env: step a BatchEnv with a batch of actions to get stacked observations, rewards, and done flags
reset_batch_env: reset all or specific environments in a BatchEnv by index and return stacked observations
close_batch_env: close all wrapped environments in a BatchEnv by calling their close methods
access_batch_env: access an individual wrapped environment inside a BatchEnv by index or forward attributes
